title: Battlepack section 0 — Weapon Stances

container.notes: Section 0 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack; see container-battlepack). NOT an st2e table: u16 entrySize (=1) at +0, u16 entryCount at +2, then entryCount one-byte entries from +4, zero padding to a multiple of 16.

records.name: header
records.where: Offset 0 of battlepack section 0 (no st2e header in this section).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per stance entry; always 1. The Workshop ignores it on read and writes 1.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of stance rows (23 in the vanilla game).

records.name: weaponStance
records.where: section 0 offset 4 + i (one byte per stance, row i = weapon stance id i; row labels: list BpWeaponStanceList)

fields.name: animation
fields.notes: Animation set used while holding a weapon of this stance.

roundTrip: Keep entrySize = 1 and entryCount equal to the number of bytes that follow.
Edit animation bytes in place; nothing points at rows.
Keep the zero padding to 16; if the row count changes, recompute the padding and shift every later battlepack section offset by the padded delta.
gaps: Which field chooses a weapon's stance (expected: a stance id inside section 13 weapon records) is outside this spec.
Whether entrySize may be anything but 1, and whether the game reads rows beyond the vanilla 23.
Padding bytes after the entries are assumed zero.
